name: Joe Fixit

abilityDetails.Disorient: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu ve blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.
abilityDetails.Petrify: Düşmanın iyileşme ve güç kazanım hızını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.

signatureAbility:
Stacked Deck
After using cards to play a Dead Man's Hand Debuff, instead of being removed, all slots are randomly assigned 1 matching suit.
Additionally, suits gain a stackable bonus during Special Attacks.
Hearts: +[5 - 10]% Debuff Duration.
Spades: +[304.72 - 914.71] Critical Rating.
Clubs: +[10 - 30]% of a bar of Power over 2 seconds.
Diamonds: +[10 - 25]% Armor Penetration.
Jackpot: Counts as all 4 Suits.
immunityDetails:
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• Kontrolleri Tersine Çevirme Bağışıklığı (Supervisor ile sinerji) 🧠

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: An enhanced immune system provides full immunity to the Poisons of the Battlerealm.

abilitySections.title: Gamblers Draw
content: Joe Fixit can hold 4 cards at a time. At max capacity, new cards replace old cards in the same order they were acquired.
Cards are drawn even if the attack was blocked.
Hearts: End a Combo with Light, +7% Life Steal.
Spades: End a Combo with Medium, +[4,067.2] Attack Rating.
Clubs: Heavy Hit, +25% Combat Power Rate.
Diamonds: Well-Timed Block, +25% Block Penetration.
When Defending a Quest Node, cards are acquired based on the Attacking Champions actions.

abilitySections.title: Dead Man's Hand - On Special Activation:
content: If Joe's hand consists of one of the following combinations, inflict the respective Debuff for 10 seconds. +5 seconds per bar of Power spent.
One Pair: Disorient, reducing Defensive Ability Accuracy and Block Proficiency by 40%.
Three of a Kind: Weakness, reducing Attack Rating by 30%.
Flush: Petrify with a potency of 60%.
Playing a hand removes all cards on the last hit of the Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On Hit, 50% chance to Inflict a Bleed Debuff dealing [3,558.8] Direct Damage over 10 seconds. +1 per Dead Man's Hand Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Final hit has a 100% chance to inflict a 2.75 second Stun Debuff.
Replay the last Dead Man's Hand Debuff that was played.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a random Dead Man's Hand Debuff.
Until the Opponent is no longer suffering any Dead Man's Hand Debuffs, Gamblers Draw card effects have +30% Potency.
